verses.original: ה֣וֹי וְאַתָּה֙ שׁוֹדֵ֗ד לֹ֣א שָׁד֔וּד וּבוֹגֵ֖ד וְלֹא־ בָ֣גְדוּ ב֑וֹ כַּהֲתִֽמְךָ֤ שׁוֹדֵד֙ תּוּשַּׁ֔ד כַּנְּלֹתְךָ֥ לִבְגֹּ֖ד יִבְגְּדוּ־ בָֽךְ׃ס
verses.transliteration: hō·w wə·’at·tāh šō·w·ḏêḏ lō šā·ḏūḏ ū·ḇō·w·ḡêḏ wə·lō- ḇā·ḡə·ḏū ḇōw ka·hă·ṯim·ḵā šō·w·ḏêḏ tūš·šaḏ kan·nə·lō·ṯə·ḵā liḇ·gōḏ yiḇ·gə·ḏū- ḇāḵ
verses.literal: Woe to you O destroyer never destroyed O traitor never betrayed When you have finished destroying you will be destroyed When you have finished betraying you will be betrayed

verses.original: יְהוָ֥ה חָנֵּ֖נוּ קִוִּ֑ינוּ לְךָ֣ הֱיֵ֤ה זְרֹעָם֙ לַבְּקָרִ֔ים אַף־ יְשׁוּעָתֵ֖נוּ בְּעֵ֥ת צָרָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh ḥān·nê·nū qiw·wî·nū lə·ḵā hĕ·yêh zə·rō·‘ām lab·bə·qā·rîm ’ap̄- yə·šū·‘ā·ṯê·nū bə·‘êṯ ṣā·rāh
verses.literal: O LORD be gracious to us We wait for You Be our strength every morning and our salvation in time of trouble

verses.original: עַמִּ֑ים נָדְד֖וּ הָמ֔וֹן מִקּ֣וֹל גּוֹיִֽם׃ נָפְצ֖וּ מֵר֣וֹמְמֻתֶ֔ךָ
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mîm nā·ḏə·ḏū hā·mō·wn miq·qō·wl gō·w·yim nā·p̄ə·ṣū mê·rō·wm·mu·ṯe·ḵā
verses.literal: The peoples flee the thunder of Your voice the nations scatter when You rise

verses.original: שְׁלַלְכֶ֔ם וְאֻסַּ֣ף הֶֽחָסִ֑יל אֹ֖סֶף כְּמַשַּׁ֥ק גֵּבִ֖ים שׁוֹקֵ֥ק בּֽוֹ׃
verses.transliteration: šə·lal·ḵem wə·’us·sap̄ he·ḥā·sîl ’ō·sep̄ kə·maš·šaq gê·ḇîm šō·w·qêq bōw
verses.literal: Your spoil, [O nations,] is gathered as by locusts . . . like a swarm of locusts men sweep over it

verses.original: יְהוָ֔ה נִשְׂגָּ֣ב כִּ֥י שֹׁכֵ֖ן מָר֑וֹם מִלֵּ֣א צִיּ֔וֹן מִשְׁפָּ֖ט וּצְדָקָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: Yah·weh niś·gāḇ kî šō·ḵên mā·rō·wm mil·lê ṣî·yō·wn miš·pāṭ ū·ṣə·ḏā·qāh
verses.literal: The LORD is exalted for He dwells on high He has filled Zion with justice and righteousness

verses.original: וְהָיָה֙ אֱמוּנַ֣ת עִתֶּ֔יךָ חֹ֥סֶן יְשׁוּעֹ֖ת חָכְמַ֣ת וָדָ֑עַת יִרְאַ֥ת יְהוָ֖ה הִ֥יא אוֹצָרֽוֹ׃ס
verses.transliteration: wə·hā·yāh ’ĕ·mū·naṯ ‘it·te·ḵā ḥō·sen yə·šū·‘ōṯ ḥā·ḵə·maṯ wā·ḏā·‘aṯ yir·’aṯ Yah·weh hî ’ō·w·ṣā·rōw
verses.literal: He will be the sure foundation for your times a storehouse of salvation wisdom and knowledge The fear of the LORD . . . is [Zion’s] treasure

verses.original: הֵ֚ן אֶרְאֶלָּ֔ם צָעֲק֖וּ חֻ֑צָה מַלְאֲכֵ֣י שָׁל֔וֹם יִבְכָּיֽוּן׃ מַ֖ר
verses.transliteration: hên ’er·’el·lām ṣā·‘ă·qū ḥu·ṣāh mal·’ă·ḵê šā·lō·wm yiḇ·kā·yūn mar
verses.literal: Behold their valiant ones cry aloud in the streets the envoys of peace weep bitterly

verses.original: מְסִלּ֔וֹת נָשַׁ֣מּוּ עֹבֵ֣ר אֹ֑רַח שָׁבַ֖ת בְּרִית֙ הֵפֵ֤ר עָרִ֔ים מָאַ֣ס לֹ֥א חָשַׁ֖ב אֱנֽוֹשׁ׃
verses.transliteration: mə·sil·lō·wṯ nā·šam·mū ‘ō·ḇêr ’ō·raḥ šā·ḇaṯ bə·rîṯ hê·p̄êr ‘ā·rîm mā·’as lō ḥā·šaḇ ’ĕ·nō·wōš
verses.literal: The highways are deserted travel . . . has ceased The treaty has been broken the witnesses are despised and human life is disregarded . . .

verses.original: אָ֔רֶץ אָבַ֤ל אֻמְלְלָה֙ לְבָנ֖וֹן הֶחְפִּ֥יר קָמַ֑ל הַשָּׁרוֹן֙ הָיָ֤ה כָּֽעֲרָבָ֔ה בָּשָׁ֖ן וְכַרְמֶֽל׃ וְנֹעֵ֥ר
verses.transliteration: ’ā·reṣ ’ā·ḇal ’um·lə·lāh lə·ḇā·nō·wn heḥ·pîr qā·mal haš·šā·rō·wn hā·yāh kā·‘ă·rā·ḇāh bā·šān wə·ḵar·mel wə·nō·‘êr
verses.literal: The land mourns [and] languishes Lebanon is ashamed and decayed Sharon is like a desert Bashan and Carmel shake off their leaves

verses.original: עַתָּ֥ה אָק֖וּם יֹאמַ֣ר יְהוָ֑ה עַתָּה֙ אֵֽרוֹמָ֔ם עַתָּ֖ה אֶנָּשֵֽׂא׃
verses.transliteration: ‘at·tāh ’ā·qūm yō·mar Yah·weh ‘at·tāh ’ê·rō·w·mām ‘at·tāh ’en·nā·śê
verses.literal: Now I will arise says the LORD Now I will lift Myself up Now I will be exalted

verses.original: תַּהֲר֥וּ חֲשַׁ֖שׁ תֵּ֣לְדוּ קַ֑שׁ רוּחֲכֶ֕ם אֵ֖שׁ תֹּאכַלְכֶֽם׃
verses.transliteration: ta·hă·rū ḥă·šaš tê·lə·ḏū qaš rū·ḥă·ḵem ’êš tō·ḵal·ḵem
verses.literal: You conceive chaff you give birth to stubble Your breath is a fire that will consume you

verses.original: עַמִּ֖ים וְהָי֥וּ מִשְׂרְפ֣וֹת שִׂ֑יד קוֹצִ֥ים כְּסוּחִ֖ים יִצַּֽתּוּ׃ס בָּאֵ֥שׁ
verses.transliteration: ‘am·mîm wə·hā·yū miś·rə·p̄ō·wṯ śîḏ qō·w·ṣîm kə·sū·ḥîm yiṣ·ṣat·tū bā·’êš
verses.literal: The peoples will be burned to ashes like thorns cut down and set ablaze

verses.original: רְחוֹקִ֖ים שִׁמְע֥וּ אֲשֶׁ֣ר עָשִׂ֑יתִי קְרוֹבִ֖ים וּדְע֥וּ גְּבֻרָתִֽי׃
verses.transliteration: rə·ḥō·w·qîm šim·‘ū ’ă·šer ‘ā·śî·ṯî qə·rō·w·ḇîm ū·ḏə·‘ū gə·ḇu·rā·ṯî
verses.literal: You who are far off hear what I have done you who are near acknowledge My might

verses.original: חַטָּאִ֔ים בְצִיּוֹן֙ פָּחֲד֤וּ רְעָדָ֖ה אָחֲזָ֥ה חֲנֵפִ֑ים מִ֣י׀ לָ֗נוּ יָג֣וּר אוֹכֵלָ֔ה אֵ֚שׁ מִי־ לָ֖נוּ יָג֥וּר עוֹלָֽם׃ מוֹקְדֵ֥י
verses.transliteration: ḥaṭ·ṭā·’îm ḇə·ṣî·yō·wn pā·ḥă·ḏū rə·‘ā·ḏāh ’ā·ḥă·zāh ḥă·nê·p̄îm mî lā·nū yā·ḡūr ’ō·w·ḵê·lāh ’êš mî- lā·nū yā·ḡūr ‘ō·w·lām mō·wq·ḏê
verses.literal: The sinners in Zion are afraid trembling grips the ungodly Who of us can dwell with a consuming fire Who of us can dwell with everlasting flames

verses.original: הֹלֵ֣ךְ צְדָק֔וֹת וְדֹבֵ֖ר מֵֽישָׁרִ֑ים מֹאֵ֞ס בְּבֶ֣צַע מַעֲשַׁקּ֗וֹת כַּפָּיו֙ נֹעֵ֤ר מִתְּמֹ֣ךְ בַּשֹּׁ֔חַד אֹטֵ֤ם אָזְנוֹ֙ מִשְּׁמֹ֣עַ דָּמִ֔ים וְעֹצֵ֥ם עֵינָ֖יו מֵרְא֥וֹת בְּרָֽע׃
verses.transliteration: hō·lêḵ ṣə·ḏā·qō·wṯ wə·ḏō·ḇêr mê·šā·rîm mō·’ês bə·ḇe·ṣa‘ ma·‘ă·šaq·qō·wṯ kap·pāw nō·‘êr mit·tə·mōḵ baš·šō·ḥaḏ ’ō·ṭêm ’ā·zə·nōw miš·šə·mō·a‘ dā·mîm wə·‘ō·ṣêm ‘ê·nāw mê·rə·’ō·wṯ bə·rā‘
verses.literal: He who walks righteously and speaks with sincerity who refuses gain from extortion whose hand never takes a bribe who stops his ears against murderous plots and shuts his eyes tightly against evil

verses.original: ה֚וּא יִשְׁכֹּ֔ן מְרוֹמִ֣ים סְלָעִ֖ים מְצָד֥וֹת מִשְׂגַּבּ֑וֹ לַחְמ֣וֹ נִתָּ֔ן מֵימָ֖יו נֶאֱמָנִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: hū yiš·kōn mə·rō·w·mîm sə·lā·‘îm mə·ṣā·ḏō·wṯ miś·gab·bōw laḥ·mōw nit·tān mê·māw ne·’ĕ·mā·nîm
verses.literal: he will dwell on the heights the mountain fortress [will be] his refuge his food will be provided [and] his water assured

verses.original: עֵינֶ֑יךָ תֶּחֱזֶ֣ינָה מֶ֥לֶךְ בְּיָפְי֖וֹ תִּרְאֶ֖ינָה אֶ֥רֶץ מַרְחַקִּֽים׃
verses.transliteration: ‘ê·ne·ḵā te·ḥĕ·ze·nāh me·leḵ bə·yā·p̄ə·yōw tir·’e·nāh ’e·reṣ mar·ḥaq·qîm
verses.literal: Your eyes will see the King in His beauty and behold a land that stretches afar

verses.original: לִבְּךָ֖ יֶהְגֶּ֣ה אֵימָ֑ה אַיֵּ֤ה סֹפֵר֙ אַיֵּ֣ה שֹׁקֵ֔ל אַיֵּ֖ה סֹפֵ֥ר אֶת־ הַמִּגְדָּלִֽים׃
verses.transliteration: lib·bə·ḵā yeh·geh ’ê·māh ’ay·yêh sō·p̄êr ’ay·yêh šō·qêl ’ay·yêh sō·p̄êr ’eṯ- ham·miḡ·dā·lîm
verses.literal: Your mind will ponder the former terror Where is he who tallies Where is he who weighs Where is he who counts the towers

verses.original: אֶת־ לֹ֣א תִרְאֶ֑ה נוֹעָ֖ז עַ֥ם עַ֣ם שָׂפָה֙ עִמְקֵ֤י מִשְּׁמ֔וֹעַ נִלְעַ֥ג לָשׁ֖וֹן אֵ֥ין בִּינָֽה׃
verses.transliteration: ’eṯ- lō ṯir·’eh nō·w·‘āz ‘am ‘am śā·p̄āh ‘im·qê miš·šə·mō·w·a‘ nil·‘aḡ lā·šō·wn ’ên bî·nāh
verses.literal: - You will no longer see the insolent . . . a people whose speech is unintelligible - who stammer in a language you cannot understand

verses.original: חֲזֵ֣ה צִיּ֔וֹן קִרְיַ֖ת מֽוֹעֲדֵ֑נוּ עֵינֶיךָ֩ תִרְאֶ֨ינָה יְרוּשָׁלִַ֜ם שַׁאֲנָ֗ן נָוֶ֣ה אֹ֤הֶל בַּל־ יִצְעָן֙ יְתֵֽדֹתָיו֙ לָנֶ֔צַח בַּל־ יִסַּ֤ע בַּל־ וְכָל־ חֲבָלָ֖יו יִנָּתֵֽקוּ׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·zêh ṣî·yō·wn qir·yaṯ mō·w·‘ă·ḏê·nū ‘ê·ne·ḵā ṯir·’e·nāh yə·rū·šā·lim ša·’ă·nān nā·weh ’ō·hel bal- yiṣ·‘ān yə·ṯê·ḏō·ṯāw lā·ne·ṣaḥ bal- yis·sa‘ bal- wə·ḵāl ḥă·ḇā·lāw yin·nā·ṯê·qū
verses.literal: Look upon Zion the city of our appointed feasts Your eyes will see Jerusalem a peaceful pasture a tent that does not wander its tent pegs . . . will not be pulled up nor will any of its cords be broken

verses.original: כִּ֣י אִם־ שָׁ֞ם אַדִּ֤יר יְהוָה֙ לָ֔נוּ מְקוֹם־ נְהָרִ֥ים רַחֲבֵ֣י יָדָ֑יִם יְאֹרִ֖ים בַּל־ אֳנִי־ שַׁ֔יִט תֵּ֤לֶךְ בּוֹ֙ לֹ֥א אַדִּ֖יר וְצִ֥י יַעַבְרֶֽנּוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî ’im- šām ’ad·dîr Yah·weh lā·nū mə·qō·wm- nə·hā·rîm ra·ḥă·ḇê yā·ḏā·yim yə·’ō·rîm bal- ’o·nî- ša·yiṭ tê·leḵ bōw lō ’ad·dîr wə·ṣî ya·‘aḇ·ren·nū
verses.literal: - But there the Majestic One our LORD [will be] for us a place of rivers and wide . . . canals where no galley with oars will row and no majestic vessel will pass

verses.original: כִּ֤י יְהוָה֙ שֹׁפְטֵ֔נוּ יְהוָ֖ה מְחֹקְקֵ֑נוּ יְהוָ֥ה מַלְכֵּ֖נוּ ה֥וּא יוֹשִׁיעֵֽנוּ׃
verses.transliteration: kî Yah·weh šō·p̄ə·ṭê·nū Yah·weh mə·ḥō·qə·qê·nū Yah·weh mal·kê·nū hū yō·wō·šî·‘ê·nū
verses.literal: For the LORD is our Judge the LORD is our lawgiver the LORD is our King [It is] He who will save us

verses.original: חֲבָלָ֑יִךְ נִטְּשׁ֖וּ בַּל־ יְחַזְּק֤וּ כֵן־ תָּרְנָם֙ בַּל־ פָּ֣רְשׂוּ נֵ֔ס אָ֣ז מַרְבֶּ֔ה עַֽד־ שָׁלָל֙ חֻלַּ֤ק פִּסְחִ֖ים בָּ֥זְזוּ בַֽז׃
verses.transliteration: ḥă·ḇā·lā·yiḵ niṭ·ṭə·šū bal- yə·ḥaz·zə·qū ḵên- tā·rə·nām bal- pā·rə·śū nês ’āz mar·beh ‘aḏ- šā·lāl ḥul·laq pis·ḥîm bā·zə·zū ḇaz
verses.literal: Your ropes are slack they cannot secure - the mast . . . or spread the sail Then an abundance vvv of spoils will be divided [and even] the lame will carry off plunder . . .

verses.original: וּבַל־ שָׁכֵ֖ן יֹאמַ֥ר חָלִ֑יתִי הָעָ֛ם הַיֹּשֵׁ֥ב בָּ֖הּ נְשֻׂ֥א עָוֺֽן׃
verses.transliteration: ū·ḇal- šā·ḵên yō·mar ḥā·lî·ṯî hā·‘ām hay·yō·šêḇ bāh nə·śu ‘ā·wōn
verses.literal: And no resident [of Zion] will say I am sick The people who dwell there will be forgiven of iniquity
